title: 3M™ PLASTIC SHEETING – 16’ x 400’ Plastic Sheeting with 388N Yellow Masking Tape
description: High-density, tear-resistant, durable polyethylene sheeting/film masks car from paint overspray and other contaminants during repairs. 3M engineered static cling makes the film easy to handle so one person can quickly cover the vehicle. The film is easy to cut so the required area can be removed with maximum speed and accuracy.
